errors.text_span: 图表共有三个类别，分别用黄色、蓝色和橙色、绿色表示
errors.evidence: The figure has two pie charts with four color-coded slices in total (yellow, blue, orange, green), not three categories.

errors.text_span: 显示了“的”字只隐不现（橙色，81.66%）和“的”字只现不隐（绿色，18.34%）
errors.evidence: The right pie chart labels the slices as “的”字只隐不现 81.66% (orange) and “的”字只显不隐 18.34% (green); the description misstates the second label as “只现不隐”.
